scope: Manually chosen interior material regions; class statistics only. No reference pixels become scene textures or spatial gains.

sky.note: Clear blue sky, excluding the reference cloud and both tree crowns; render additionally requires background material index0.

paving.note: Dry central paving, away from the broad left wet regions and joints; original fine mineral/shadow variation is retained in robust quantiles.

roof.note: The two main roof planes; avoid ridge fittings, gold ornaments and the front gable.

painted_timber.note: Two red column shafts away from fittings and bases; render requires the existing reference4_red material.

gilding.note: Architectural/altar gold, excluding black gaps by the declared warm-gold chroma filter; source mask uses actual material indices, not pixel colour classification.

limits: Selections compare material categories under inferred lighting, not measured material samples or pixel-aligned geometry.
